name: Trail Runner Shoes
description: Lightweight trail shoes with a grippy outsole and a breathable mesh upper. Built for rocky singletrack and muddy fire roads.

name: Lithium Power Bank 20,000mAh
description: High-capacity lithium-ion power bank with dual USB-C output and pass-through charging.

name: Insulated Water Bottle 32oz
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated stainless steel bottle. Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours.

name: Merino Base Layer
description: Midweight merino wool crew that regulates temperature and resists odor on multi-day trips.

name: Bear Deterrent Spray
description: EPA-registered bear deterrent with a 30-foot range and glow-in-the-dark safety clip.

name: Ultralight 2-Person Tent
description: Freestanding two-person tent under three pounds with two doors and two vestibules.

name: Headlamp 400 Lumens
description: Rechargeable headlamp with red night mode and a lockout switch to prevent accidental activation in your pack.

name: Canister Camp Stove
description: Compact folding stove with a piezo igniter. Boils a liter of water in under four minutes.

name: Packable Rain Shell
description: Three-layer waterproof shell that stuffs into its own pocket. Pit zips for ventilation.

name: Carbon Trekking Poles
description: Collapsible carbon fiber poles with cork grips and quick-lock adjusters.

name: Satellite Messenger
description: Two-way satellite messaging and SOS with global coverage. Subscription required for activation.

name: Wool Hiking Socks (3-pack)
description: Cushioned merino blend socks with a seamless toe. Three pairs per pack.
